title: Project Scaffolding, Tooling, and Continuous Integration
objective: Create the repository skeleton, dependency management, configuration system, logging, exception hierarchy, and CI pipeline so that every subsequent stage has a consistent, enforced foundation to build on.
context_for_agent: Nothing exists yet. This stage produces no domain logic — it produces the environment in which domain logic will be written. Get the guardrails (typing, linting, coverage) strict now, because loosening them later is easy and tightening them later is not.

tasks.name: Repository skeleton
tasks.detail: Create the full directory structure defined in the global contract's repository_layout. Every Python package directory gets an __init__.py. Create empty-but-present tests/unit/ and tests/integration/ trees mirroring src/.

tasks.name: Dependency management
tasks.detail: Create pyproject.toml declaring the project, Python 3.11+ requirement, and dependency groups: 'core' (pydantic, sqlalchemy, alembic, fastapi, uvicorn, psycopg, pgvector, pyyaml, structlog), 'vision' (opencv-python, ultralytics, paddleocr/paddlepaddle, torch, torchvision, numpy, pillow), 'dev' (pytest, pytest-asyncio, pytest-cov, pytest-mock, hypothesis, freezegun, testcontainers, ruff, mypy). Vision dependencies MUST be an optional extra so that logic-only stages and CI can install a lightweight environment. Pin major versions.

tasks.name: Configuration system
tasks.detail: Implement src/multicam_tracker/config.py using Pydantic Settings. Define a Settings class with nested sections: database (host, port, user, password, dbname, pool size), storage (thumbnail_dir, media_dir), vision (model paths, device 'cpu'|'cuda', detection frame sample rate), thresholds (loaded from config/thresholds.yaml), retention (sighting_ttl_days, thumbnail_ttl_days), api (host, port, auth_enabled). Settings load from environment variables prefixed MCT_ with nested delimiter '__', falling back to a .env file. Provide a cached get_settings() accessor. Create config/thresholds.yaml populated with the default_thresholds from the global contract, and a committed .env.example.

tasks.name: Exception hierarchy
tasks.detail: Implement src/multicam_tracker/exceptions.py with root MulticamTrackerError(Exception) and subclasses: ConfigurationError, ValidationError, StorageError, TopologyError, MatchingError, IngestError, VisionError, PathReconstructionError, AuthorizationError. Each accepts a message and an optional context dict serialized into the string representation.

tasks.name: Structured logging
tasks.detail: Implement src/multicam_tracker/logging_config.py using structlog. JSON output in production, human-readable console output when a DEBUG/dev flag is set. Provide get_logger(name). Bind a correlation_id contextvar so a single pipeline run or API request can be traced across modules. Configure stdlib logging to route through structlog so third-party library logs are captured too.

tasks.name: Clock abstraction
tasks.detail: Implement src/multicam_tracker/clock.py exposing a Clock protocol with now_utc() -> datetime, a SystemClock implementation, and a FixedClock test implementation. All code that needs the current time MUST take a Clock via dependency injection rather than calling datetime.now() directly. This is what makes time-dependent tests deterministic.

tasks.name: Lint, type, and test configuration
tasks.detail: Configure ruff (line length 100, enable E, F, I, N, UP, B, SIM, RUF rulesets) and mypy (strict = true for src/multicam_tracker, ignore_missing_imports for CV libs) in pyproject.toml. Configure pytest with testpaths, markers ('unit', 'integration', 'slow', 'requires_gpu', 'requires_models'), asyncio_mode=auto, and coverage settings with fail_under=85.

tasks.name: Docker compose for local development
tasks.detail: Create docker-compose.yml defining a postgres service using the pgvector/pgvector:pg16 image with a named volume, healthcheck, and environment wired to match the default settings. Do not containerize the app itself yet — that is stage 19.

tasks.name: Developer scripts and Makefile
tasks.detail: Create a Makefile (or scripts/) with targets: install, lint, format, typecheck, test-unit, test-integration, test-all, db-up, db-down, ci (runs lint + typecheck + test-all).

tasks.name: CI pipeline
tasks.detail: Create .github/workflows/ci.yml running on push and pull request: checkout, install Python 3.11, install core+dev deps (NOT vision extras, to keep CI fast), run ruff check, ruff format --check, mypy, pytest with coverage, and fail the build if coverage drops below 85%. Add a separate optional job gated on a label that installs vision extras and runs tests marked 'requires_models'.

tasks.name: Documentation seed
tasks.detail: Create README.md (project overview, quickstart, architecture diagram in mermaid, how to run tests) and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md restating the pipeline stages. Create CONTRIBUTING.md documenting the stage-based build process and commit convention.

tests_substage.description: Prove the foundation itself works. These tests are small but they catch an entire class of later failures.

cases: loads defaults successfully when no environment variables are set
environment variables with MCT_ prefix override defaults
nested delimiter correctly populates nested sections (e.g. MCT_DATABASE__PORT)
thresholds.yaml values are loaded and accessible
missing required setting raises ConfigurationError with the offending field name
invalid type (e.g. port='abc') raises a validation error rather than coercing silently
get_settings() returns a cached instance (same object identity on repeat call)
every defined exception subclasses MulticamTrackerError
context dict is included in the string representation
exception with no context renders cleanly without a trailing separator
get_logger returns a bound logger
emitted log record in JSON mode is valid parseable JSON
correlation_id bound in context appears in subsequent log records
correlation_id is isolated between concurrent async contexts
SystemClock.now_utc() returns a timezone-aware datetime in UTC
FixedClock returns the exact configured instant on every call
FixedClock can be advanced and reflects the new instant
postgres container starts and becomes healthy
a plain connection can be established using the settings-derived DSN
the vector extension can be created successfully (CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector)
integration_tests.note: Mark these 'integration'. Use testcontainers so CI does not depend on a developer's local compose stack.

cases: ruff check passes on the freshly scaffolded repository
mypy strict passes on the freshly scaffolded repository
the full pytest suite runs green and reports coverage
integration_tests.note: Implement these as a CI assertion (the ci make target) rather than as pytest tests calling subprocesses.

exit_criteria: A fresh clone plus 'make install' produces a working environment
'make ci' passes end to end with zero lint, type, or test failures
'make db-up' brings up Postgres with pgvector available
No hardcoded credentials, paths, hosts, or thresholds exist anywhere in src/
Coverage gate is active and enforced at 85%
